notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.7
notes.notes:
-Fixed Save and load game bugs
-Fixed controller bugs

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.5
notes.notes: Here it is folks, the big one: double the levels, a new save system, a brand new ranged character, controller support AND couch coop!

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.3
notes.notes: Added a blocking maneuver. If sales continue to rise, there is the potential for magic and ranged attacks to be added. Enjoy!!

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.21
notes.notes: Fixed some UI Scaling issues, added fun physics to hanging skeletons and improved the graphics slightly.

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.2
notes.notes: Thank you all for your continued support of Gutting Goblins! We heard your plea for loading screens, and thus we have grant your request! New chests have been added, gravity physics have been vastly improved, and the code has been optimized to allow for far superior performance. We hope you enjoy the continued updates, and we'll keep sending them your way as long as you ask for them!

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.14
notes.notes: -Fixed Gravity Bug that occurred from last update

notes.title: Gutting Goblins Version 1.135
notes.notes: -Added asset changes to Mac and Linux builds for optimized play

notes.title: Gutting Goblins Compatibility Update
notes.notes:
Gutting Goblins! should now have all the required files for playing on both Mac and Linux. Furthermore, we have also allowed Steam Remote Play to be tested out, however I would advise a bluetooth mouse and keyboard. If you find any issues with this compatibility update, feel free to email me so I can rectify the issue. 

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Gutting Goblins Version 1.12
notes.notes:
-Menu design changed;
-Goblins no longer spawn beyond outer walls.

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.11
notes.notes: Tweaked the scoring again. Should be pristine, now.

notes.title: Gutting Goblins! Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hey there! Thank you for your continued support of Gutting Goblins! It means the world to those involved in it's creation, and we have updated a few things for better playability. The changes are as follows:

-Scoring is fixed, now your high score is only updated after you've defeated the boss. 
-Doors are now wider, as to let the goblins get into rooms without getting stuck.
-Overall code optimization, should run a tad quicker. 

If you guys continue to support the game, we'll keep making improvements for you!
